pr_title: Change editor flip hotkeys to perform flips around origin
pr_body:
Still need to figure out the UX for the on-screen control versions of these. For now I'm changing the hotkeys to trigger the behaviour people are used to, while leaving the buttons performing the more localised flip.

This also adds customisation of the hotkeys assigned to these actions.

Closes https://github.com/ppy/osu/issues/15071

issue_context.title: Flipping across playfield axis in the editor
issue_context.body:
### Discussed in https://github.com/ppy/osu/discussions/15064
Originally posted by **Okorin** October 13, 2021 Yo, so as I kind-of implied on my twitter, I tried out making a map with the lazer editor and wanted to somehow dump my experiences somewhere so here goes. All this was done on **osu! 2021.1006.1-lazer** I noticed (or couldn't find) that there's any way to rotate an object across the playfield or the axis. By default it flips your current selection within the box that is selected, which makes using symmetry in any mapping very tricky because right now i'm essentially just eyeballing it (so e.g. making something like this required me to just eyeball whatever this is after ) ![example](https://i.imgur.com/mLFYmlv.png) would also be cool to have that somehow and i couldn't find an open issue for it so if i'm doing this wrong please lmk

review_comments: Thoughts on moving the computation of `selectionRange` into this `handleFlip()` call? Seems weird to pass a value that's never used in the scope of the method that's passing it. Again, not caused by this pull, but adding the `flipOverOrigin` param has amplified the weirdness of this for me.
Wouldn't that cause it to be recalculated per object? Seems like it could get expensive if flipping a whole beatmap.
Hm, ok, missed the for loop somehow. Fair point.

I just noticed that if you press the vertical flip keybind then the pattern will flip horizontally. That's not a fault of this PR (was already wrong, this method isn't checking the direction), but given that we're touching this then may as well fix it here?
I'll just make it do nothing for now, yeah?
